lines.en: label goodboy:
scene black
Today, I am going to be a good boy.
lines.zh: 今天，我要做个好孩子。

lines.en: scene sky
I buckle my belt and tie both my shoes, cause that’s what all the good boys do.
lines.zh: 我扣好腰带，系好两只鞋，因为好孩子都这么做。

lines.en: I put on my backpack and fasten my gloves, cause that is what a good boy does.
lines.zh: 我背上书包，戴好手套，因为好孩子就是这么做的。

lines.en: I shoveled the driveway and vacuumed the floor. I folded my laundry, I did all my chores.
lines.zh: 我铲了车道上的雪，把地板吸得一干二净。我叠好了衣服，干完了所有的家务。

lines.en: I washed the whole house, I cleaned all our rooms. I took out the garbage, pulled hair off the brooms.
lines.zh: 我把整栋房子擦洗了一遍，把每个房间都打扫干净。我倒了垃圾，把缠在扫帚上的头发捋了下来。

lines.en: I fed both the dogs so they wouldn’t bark. Can I go outside now? I’ll be home before dark.
lines.zh: 我喂了那两条狗，好让它们别叫。我现在能出去玩了吗？天黑之前我就回家。

lines.en: I’ll look both ways when I’m crossing the street. I’ll eat all my veggies and say no to sweets.
lines.zh: 过马路的时候我会两边都看。我会把蔬菜全吃光，对甜食说不。

lines.en: I’ll take off my pants, stay quiet for you. I won’t tell a soul. I promise it’s true.
lines.zh: 我会脱下裤子，为你保持安静。我不会告诉任何人。我保证是真的。

lines.en: I’m such a good boy, so why can’t I play? Why can’t I have friends? I’ll do what you say.
lines.zh: 我是个这么乖的孩子，那为什么不能去玩？为什么不能有朋友？你说什么我都照做。

lines.en: I’m such a good boy. Obedient too. So easy to touch, so easy to use.
lines.zh: 我是个这么乖的孩子。也很听话。这么好摸，这么好用。

lines.en: So easy to break, yet you always play rough. I’m such a good boy. Can’t that be enough?
lines.zh: 这么容易弄坏，可你每次都玩得那么粗。我是个这么乖的孩子。这样还不够吗？

lines.en: I buckle my belt and tie both my shoes, cause that’s what all the good boys do.
lines.zh: 我扣好腰带，系好两只鞋，因为好孩子都这么做。

lines.en: I put on my backpack and keep my mouth shut. Then saunter to school with a pain in my gut.
lines.zh: 我背上书包，闭上嘴巴。然后一路晃到学校，肚子里疼得发慌。

lines.en: Today, I am going to be a good boy.
lines.zh: 今天，我要做个好孩子。

lines.en: scene goodboyneg1
Weather.
lines.zh: 天气。

lines.en: I take in the scenery as I make my way down the street and, strangely enough, the nice spring breeze actually cheers me up today.
lines.zh: 我沿街走着，一路打量周围的景色；说来也怪，今天这阵宜人的春风居然真的让我心情好了起来。

lines.en: Normally, the feeling of wind against my cheeks annoys me since I learned very early on in life that most diseases are transmitted through the air and, well, I’ve just always equated {i}more{/i} air to bad.
lines.zh: 通常情况下，风刮在脸上会让我烦躁，因为我人生很早就学到，大多数疾病是通过空气传播的，嗯，我一向把「空气{i}多{/i}」和「不好」画上等号。

lines.en: Today, I’m fine with taking my chances, though.
lines.zh: 不过今天，我愿意赌一把。

lines.en: Because today, I'm going on an {i}adventure.{/i}
lines.zh: 因为今天，我要去{i}冒险{/i}。

lines.en: I heard through the grapevine that there’s a wonderful place nearby where dreams can become reality.
lines.zh: 我是从小道消息那儿听来的，说附近有个奇妙的地方，在那里梦想可以变成现实。

lines.en: I’m not sure where I heard it but, then again, I’m not really known for my above average memory.
lines.zh: 我不记得是从哪儿听来的了，不过话说回来，我本来也不以记性好著称。

lines.en: In fact, I’d probably forget to even eat if it weren’t for my wonderful [niece] Ami, who is always doing things to make me happy.
lines.zh: 事实上，如果不是我那无比出色的 [niece] Ami，我大概连吃饭都会忘——她总在做各种事让我开心。

lines.en: I am very glad that Ami exists because Ami is good.
lines.zh: 我很庆幸 Ami 存在于这个世界上，因为 Ami 是好的。

lines.en: Ami is so cute.
lines.zh: Ami 太可爱了。

lines.en: Sometimes, when I’m looking at Ami, I can even remember extra things.
lines.zh: 有时候，我看着 Ami 的时候，甚至能多想起一些事情。

lines.en: They normally vanish after a few seconds, though, because I would prefer to think of other things like sex or boobies.
lines.zh: 不过它们通常几秒钟之后就消失了，因为我更愿意去想别的东西，比如性，或者奶子。

lines.en: Boobies are so great.
lines.zh: 奶子真是太棒了。

lines.en: : I hope I see boobies today...
lines.zh: : 希望今天能看到奶子……

lines.en: scene goodboy0
: Surprise!
lines.zh: : 惊喜！

lines.en: : Woah! What are you two doing here?
lines.zh: : 哇！你们两个在这儿干什么？

lines.en: The figure on the right and I do our celebratory dance together- the one we practiced in the corridors of [kumon_mi_high] before I encountered a talking net.
lines.zh: 右边那个家伙和我一起跳起了我们庆祝用的舞——那是在我遇上一张会说话的网之前，在 [kumon_mi_high] 的走廊里练的。

lines.en: : We heard that you are going on an adventure!
lines.zh: : 我们听说你要去冒险！

lines.en: : Wonderful! Fantastic! Tell us more!
lines.zh: : 太棒了！妙极了！再多说点！

lines.en: : Hmm...Well, I don’t really have any major plans, but I was thinking of maybe taking a trip to somewhere I’m familiar with to find out if this new lease on life impacts how I see it!
lines.zh: : 嗯……其实我也没什么大计划，不过我在想，也许可以去一个我熟悉的地方走一趟，看看这份新的人生会不会改变我看待它的方式！

lines.en: : Sounds to me like {i}somebody{/i} has been thinking about perception!
lines.zh: : 听起来，{i}有人{/i}一直在思考「认知」这件事呢！

lines.en: : Oh, you.
lines.zh: : 哦，你呀。

lines.en: We dance again for good measure.
lines.zh: 我们又跳了一遍，算是加演。

lines.en: : Do you not think it is strange that the world appears so bright today?
lines.zh: : 你不觉得今天的世界亮得有点反常吗？

lines.en: : That’s right! That’s right! What happened to the snow?
lines.zh: : 对啊！对啊！雪都到哪儿去了？

lines.en: : Hmm...that’s a good question. You know, I feel like somebody told me something about snow recently, but I can’t really remember who it was.
lines.zh: : 嗯……问得好。你这么一说，我好像记得最近有人跟我讲过雪的事，但我实在想不起是谁了。

lines.en: : Someone wonderful! Someone with eyes!
lines.zh: : 某个很棒的人！某个有眼睛的人！

lines.en: : Well, I’d sure hope so.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也希望是。

lines.en: : It melts! Returns to the sky! Only to return when the world reverts!
lines.zh: : 它融化了！回到天上去了！只等世界回溯时再回来！

lines.en: : But reverts to what?! And what is its rightful state?!
lines.zh: : 可回溯到什么？！它本来的状态又是什么？！

lines.en: : An excellent question! One we are too insignificant to answer!
lines.zh: : 好问题！一个我们太过渺小而答不上来的问题！

lines.en: : I think you two are doing a bang-up job and should really start giving yourselves a little more credit.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你们两个干得相当出色，真该多给自己一点信心。

lines.en: : {s}ssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssss{/s}
lines.zh: : {s}ssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssss{/s}

lines.en: : {s}kkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk{/s}
lines.zh: : {s}kkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk{/s}

lines.en: : I wouldn’t mind if that part stopped, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我还是希望这段能停一停。

lines.en: : Tell us, sinner! Who would you like to speak to?
lines.zh: : 告诉我们吧，罪人！你想和谁说话？

lines.en: : You’ll let me choose?
lines.zh: : 你们会让我自己选？

lines.en: : Whoever you want! So long as we want them!
lines.zh: : 你想选谁都行！只要也是我们想选的人！

lines.en: : But how am I supposed to choose someone if I don’t know who you’re okay with me choosing?
lines.zh: : 可如果我不知道你们允许我选谁，我该怎么选？

lines.en: : Fall into your ideas!
lines.zh: : 沉进你的念头里去！

lines.en: : Pick a name! Speak a name! Any name!
lines.zh: : 报个名字！说出个名字！随便什么名字！

lines.en: : How about...
: Maya?
lines.zh: : Maya 怎么样？

lines.en: : Denied!
lines.zh: : 驳回！

lines.en: : The one you speak of appears to be busy at the moment! Choose someone else!
lines.zh: : 你说的那个人现在似乎正忙着！换一个！

lines.en: : We demand it! Command it!
lines.zh: : 我们要求！我们命令！

lines.en: : You know, I think I’ll just let you guys choose for me.
lines.zh: : 你们知道吗，我觉得还是让你们替我选吧。

lines.en: : Excellent choice!
lines.zh: : 明智的选择！

lines.en: : Splendid decision!
lines.zh: : 绝妙的决定！

lines.en: scene black
The two figures make their way over to me without walking. Their bodies glide, but not all parts of them move at the same time.
lines.zh: 那两个人影不用走路就朝我靠了过来。他们的身体在滑行，但并不是每个部位都以同样的速度移动。

lines.en: When all aspects are reunited, they hold their hands in the air.
lines.zh: 等所有部分重新归位，他们把双手举到了空中。

lines.en: I can feel the world around me grow hotter the higher their hands become, but I doubt that’s relevant information.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到，他们的手举得越高，周围的世界就越热，不过我怀疑这信息没什么用。

lines.en: : This will hurt you! The pain will be great!
lines.zh: : 这会弄疼你！会很痛！

lines.en: : Your arms will bend back! Your body will ache!
lines.zh: : 你的手臂会向后弯折！你的身体会酸痛！

lines.en: : Just do it already.
lines.zh: : 那就快点动手吧。

lines.en: Without speaking any more words, the figures slip their hands inside of me.
lines.zh: 那两个人影不再说话，把手伸进了我体内。

lines.en: They tug away at my organs as if they are levers, carefully selecting the coordinates of a certain place in a certain time.
lines.zh: 他们像扳动拉杆一样拽着我的内脏，仔细挑选着某个时间、某个地点的坐标。

lines.en: I can only wonder what wonders await.
lines.zh: 我只能好奇，等着我的会是怎样的奇观。

scene goodboy1
An unfamiliar hallway in a familiar plane of existence.
lines.zh: 一段陌生的走廊，位于一个熟悉的存在层面。

lines.en: The scent of old textbooks lingers through the corridor like the ghosts of students past, stuck endlessly traversing the halls in hopes of uncovering some sort of escape route.
lines.zh: 旧课本的气味在走廊里萦绕不散，像往届学生的幽灵，无休止地在厅堂里穿行，指望找出某条逃出去的路。

lines.en: I recall a time when I was younger and cut my hand on the glass of a window that I attempted to climb out of.
lines.zh: 我想起小时候有一次想从窗户爬出去，被玻璃割伤了手。

lines.en: I fell two stories and landed on my ankle in a way that made it incredibly difficult to walk for at least two weeks.
lines.zh: 我从两层楼高摔了下去，落地时崴了脚，至少有两个星期走路都极其困难。

lines.en: During that time, I grew closer to someone who would one day leave me.
lines.zh: 在那段时间里，我和一个人亲近了起来——一个总有一天会离开我的人。

lines.en: Now, every time I look out a window-
lines.zh: 从那以后，每次我望向窗外——

lines.en: Or look down at my hands-
lines.zh: 或者低头看自己的手——

lines.en: Or look at anything, really-
lines.zh: 或者其实，看向任何东西——

lines.en: I have to remind myself to forget.
lines.zh: 我都得提醒自己忘了它。

lines.en: I think that same reason is why the ghosts of this hall are stuck, looping around in circles for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: 我想，这也是为什么这条走廊里的幽灵被困住，在永恒的循环里一圈圈打转。

lines.en: But I think a lot of things-
lines.zh: 不过我「想」的事情多了去了——

lines.en: And I am seldom correct about any of them.
lines.zh: 而其中很少有几件是对的。

lines.en: In fact, I don’t even believe in ghosts.
lines.zh: 事实上，我连鬼都不信。

lines.en: I just think the idea of this place being devoid of anything other than the scent of stale textbooks is far too lonely for even someone who’s already given up on the world.
lines.zh: 我只是觉得，要让这个地方除了发霉课本的气味之外空无一物，对一个早就放弃了这个世界的人来说也太孤独了。

lines.en: So I will pretend.
lines.zh: 所以我要假装。

lines.en: I’ll pretend that this unfamiliar hallway is full of life-
lines.zh: 我要假装这条陌生的走廊里充满生机——

lines.en: And as I make my way toward the end of it and back to the world that I call home-
lines.zh: 而当我走向它的尽头、回到我称之为家的那个世界时——

lines.en: I will wave at every single spirit along the way.
lines.zh: 我会向沿途每一个幽灵挥手。

lines.en: : Hm? Who are you?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你是谁？

lines.en: scene goodboy2
Someone appears, though I couldn’t tell you who.
lines.zh: 有人出现了，虽然我说不上来是谁。

lines.en: : Are you a new teacher or something?
lines.zh: : 你是新来的老师还是什么？

lines.en: : Yeah.
lines.zh: : 算是吧。

lines.en: : Well...what are you doing here now, then? School ended like five hours ago.
lines.zh: : 那你现在在这儿干什么？学校五小时前就放学了。

lines.en: : If school ended five hours ago, what are {i}you{/i} doing here?
lines.zh: : 如果学校五小时前就放学了，{i}你{/i}又在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : I don’t think there’s any rule that says I have to tell you that.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得有哪条规定说我必须告诉你。

lines.en: : And I don’t think there’s any rule that says I have to tell {i}you{/i} either.
lines.zh: : 我也不觉得有哪条规定说我必须告诉{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Well, then I guess we can both pretend we never saw each other and just completely forget that this encounter ever happened.
lines.zh: : 那好吧，我看我们俩就当从没见过彼此，把这次相遇彻底忘掉就行了。

lines.en: : Or we can have sex.
lines.zh: : 或者我们可以做爱。

lines.en: I decide to shoot my shot because this is obviously a delusion.
lines.zh: 我决定碰一碰运气，因为这显然是我自己在发疯。

lines.en: : You...do realize I’m a student, right?
lines.zh: : 你……知道我是学生吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. But that’s never really stopped me before.
lines.zh: : 知道。不过这从来也没真的拦住过我。

lines.en: : Ah. So you’re one of those.
lines.zh: : 啊。那你就是那种人了。

lines.en: : Are you one of those as well?
lines.zh: : 那你也是那种人吗？

lines.en: : Sorry, but I already have a boyfriend. And the two of us are pretty serious, so...yeah.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我已经有男朋友了。而且我们俩感情挺认真的，所以……嗯。

lines.en: : Oh well. Worth a shot.
lines.zh: : 好吧。值得一试。

lines.en: : I guess if we’re not going to do anything, though, could you step out of the way so I can find my way out of this dream?
lines.zh: : 不过既然我们不会做什么，那你能不能让开点，好让我找到走出这个梦的路？

lines.en: : Dream?...Wait, are you hallucinating right now?
lines.zh: : 梦？……等等，你现在是在产生幻觉吗？

lines.en: : Because if you’re just pretending to be insane so you can get away with asking me to screw you, I wasn’t really planning on telling anyone.
lines.zh: : 因为如果你只是装疯卖傻，好借机让我跟你上床，我本来也不打算告诉任何人。

lines.en: : People would probably just think I’m bragging or something anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正别人大概也只会觉得我在吹牛什么的。

lines.en: : Are you telling me that you’re actually real?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你是真的？

lines.en: : That’s what I’m telling you, yeah.
lines.zh: : 我就是这个意思，对。

lines.en: : And this...hallway? Or school, I guess?
lines.zh: : 那这条……走廊？或者说学校？

lines.en: : [[REDACTED].
lines.zh: : [已编辑].

lines.en: : I figured you’d know that since you’re apparently a teacher here.
lines.zh: : 我以为你知道呢，毕竟你显然是这儿的老师。

lines.en: : Unless that was a lie and you’re really just here to try and snatch up some schoolgirl for your own...personal use or something.
lines.zh: : 除非那是谎话，你其实只是来这儿想拐个女学生，供你自己……私人使用什么的。

lines.en: : You know what? I think I’m just going to keep exploring.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？我想我还是继续探险吧。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. Have fun.
lines.zh: : 哦，好。玩得开心。

lines.en: : Can I ask you something before you go, though? From one totally random person who was never here to another.
lines.zh: : 不过你走之前我能问你一件事吗？一个从没来过这儿的路人问另一个从没来过这儿的路人。

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 说吧。

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : Are you a good boy?
lines.zh: : 你是个好孩子吗？

lines.en: scene goodboy3
: Wha-
The girl pops.
lines.zh: 那个女孩「啵」的一声爆掉了。

lines.en: Several feet behind her and in the center of the hall, a chair appears.
lines.zh: 在她身后几英尺、走廊正中央的位置，出现了一把椅子。

lines.en: I’m competent enough right now to understand that this feels like something out of a horror movie, but it doesn’t change the fact that I feel compelled to sit down.
lines.zh: 我现在还算清醒，明白这感觉像恐怖片里的场面，但这并不影响我被一股力量推着想要坐下去。

lines.en: But I guess in a school with no one there, there’s not much else to do.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，在一间没人的学校里，也没什么别的事可做。

lines.en: Even if I were to continue exploring, I doubt I’d find anything of value.
lines.zh: 就算我继续探索，我怀疑也找不到什么有价值的东西。

lines.en: There might be an outdated encyclopedia or an old anatomical dummy still tucked away somewhere unseen, but I’m not sure how plausible it is to carry something back from a dream.
lines.zh: 也许某个没人注意的角落里还塞着一套过期的百科全书，或者一具旧的人体模型，但我不确定从梦里把东西带回来有多靠谱。

lines.en: Nor am I even sure if this is a dream anymore to begin with based on the testimony of the girl who just popped.
lines.zh: 而且，就凭刚刚那个「啵」一声爆掉的女孩的证词，我现在连这是不是梦都不确定了。

lines.en: Oh well.
lines.zh: 算了。

lines.en: I guess I’ll sit on the chair after all.
lines.zh: 我还是坐到那把椅子上去吧。

lines.en: And if I pop, I pop.
lines.zh: 要是我「啵」一声爆掉了，那就爆吧。

lines.en: At least then, I’ll know if any of this is actually happening.
lines.zh: 至少到那时，我就知道这一切到底是不是真的在发生了。

lines.en: scene black
On my way to the chair, I hear another set of footsteps, but see no one at all.
lines.zh: 走向椅子的路上，我听见了另一阵脚步声，却一个人也没看见。

lines.en: As I sit down, the scent of cherry blossoms joins forces with that of the old books.
lines.zh: 我坐下时，樱花的气味加入了旧书的味道。

lines.en: And while I don’t particularly dislike it-
lines.zh: 虽然我并不特别讨厌它——

lines.en: It makes me want to vomit.
lines.zh: 它却让我想吐。

lines.en: I’m glad I decided to sit down, as I’m suddenly feeling very dizzy.
lines.zh: 我很庆幸自己决定坐下，因为我突然晕得厉害。

lines.en: And as the acids in my stomach strap on their climbing gear and begin their ascent through my esophagus, I begin to realize that this is significantly more real than I want it to be.
lines.zh: 就在胃里的酸液系上攀登装备、开始沿着食道往上爬的时候，我开始意识到，这一切远比我希望的要真实得多。

lines.en: I don’t want to adventure anymore.
lines.zh: 我不想再冒险了。

lines.en: I want to go home.
lines.zh: 我想回家。

lines.en: scene goodboy4
Life is filled with treasures in every little thing. We just normally have to move a hideous looking rock or two before picking them out of the dirt.
lines.zh: 生活里的每一件小东西都藏着宝贝。只不过我们通常得先搬开一两块长得丑不拉叽的石头，才能把它们从土里挑出来。

lines.en: But once we clean them off, killing away the bacteria and insects, we can watch in awe as they spring back to life in the palms of our hands.
lines.zh: 可一旦我们把它们清理干净，杀掉细菌和虫子，就能惊叹地看着它们在掌心重新活过来。

lines.en: Squirming around like little, glowing maggots- those treasures begin to take form.
lines.zh: 像一条条发着光的小蛆一样扭来扭去——那些宝贝开始成形。

lines.en: And while that form may appear like nothing more than another hideous rock to someone else, the fact that they sprung to life in {i}our{/i} hands makes us love them.
lines.zh: 虽然在别人眼里，那形状也许不过是又一块丑陋的石头，可它们是在{i}我们{/i}掌心里活过来的，这一点就足以让我们爱上它们。

lines.en: This chair is far more comfortable than I want it to be.
lines.zh: 这把椅子舒服得远超我的预期。

lines.en: : {i}You’re such a good boy.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你真是个好孩子。{/i}

lines.en: One more thing I’ve found that I hate about this new environment is how, in its decay, the walls of this building have developed cracks.
lines.zh: 关于这个新环境，我又发现了一件讨厌的事：这栋楼在腐朽的过程中，墙上裂开了缝。

lines.en: Those cracks are able to mangle the sounds of wind, converting them from something I already dislike into something that makes me wish I’d never woken up this morning.
lines.zh: 那些裂缝能把风声扭曲，把它从一种我本就讨厌的东西，变成一种让我希望自己今早根本没醒过来的东西。

lines.en: I know no one else is here, but I can’t shake the feeling that I’ve been being watched since I first heard footsteps.
lines.zh: 我知道这里没有别人，但从我第一次听见脚步声起，那种被人盯着的感觉就挥之不去。

lines.en: Even now, the footsteps grow closer.
lines.zh: 就连现在，脚步声也越来越近了。

lines.en: Louder.
lines.zh: 越来越响。

lines.en: They surround me- mixing with the wind as it once again assaults my skin.
lines.zh: 它们把我团团围住——和风混在一处，风又一次袭击着我的皮肤。

lines.en: And while my instinct is to cover my face to avoid disease, the parts of me that have grown tired of living a life of avoidance keep them strapped down.
lines.zh: 虽然我的本能是捂住脸免得生病，但我身上那些厌倦了逃避人生的部分，把手牢牢按住了。

lines.en: The contaminated air finds its way into my lungs.
lines.zh: 被污染的空气钻进了我的肺。

lines.en: It becomes a part of me.
lines.zh: 它成了我的一部分。

lines.en: I am infected.
lines.zh: 我被感染了。

lines.en: scene goodboy5
Sometimes, when I don’t have anything else to think about, I like to focus really hard and see if I can feel my blood move through my veins.
lines.zh: 有时候，当我没别的事可想的时候，我喜欢非常专注地去感受，看自己能不能感觉到血液在血管里流动。

lines.en: I don’t know why I felt compelled to tell you that, but you’re all I have to talk to in here.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己为什么非要跟你说这个，但在这里头，你是我唯一能说话的对象。

lines.en: And since you never say anything, I’m the one who needs to fill the void.
lines.zh: 既然你从来不吭声，那就得由我来填满这片空白。

lines.en: What is it that {i}you{/i} would like to talk about?
lines.zh: {i}你{/i}想聊点什么呢？

lines.en: You can choose any topic you like.
lines.zh: 任何话题都随你挑。

lines.en: So long as it’s the topic I want you to choose.
lines.zh: 只要是我希望你挑的那个话题。

lines.zh: : 那你的脚踝呢？你觉得还能走吗？

lines.en: : Reeeeeeally?
: Don’t tell me you’re too embarrassed to accept a piggyback ride from your [[REDACTED].

lines.zh: : 比如什么？你又要跟我炫耀你{i}女朋友{/i}了？因为我开始觉得你大概是{i}想{/i}让我吃醋。

lines.en: scene goodboy7
A sudden popping noise drags me back to reality and I notice that I must have dozed off for a second.
lines.zh: 一阵突如其来的「啵」声把我拽回现实，我这才注意到自己大概打了个盹儿。

lines.en: It’s gotten a little darker since I last looked outside, so I’m pretty sure that I’ve been in...wherever this place is for at least a few hours.
lines.zh: 比起我上次看窗外，天色暗了一些，所以我敢肯定我已经在这个……不管这是什么地方待了好几个小时。

lines.en: And as much as I’d like to head home, I still don’t even know how to get out.
lines.zh: 虽然我很想回家，但我连该怎么出去都不知道。

lines.en: I’ve learned in the past that windows are unreliable, and every single staircase in this corridor has been blocked off by colossal mounds of dirt and rubble.
lines.zh: 我以前就领教过，窗户靠不住；而这条走廊里每一处楼梯，都被成堆的泥土和碎石堵死了。

lines.en: I’m not...going to die here, am I?
lines.zh: 我……不会要死在这儿吧？

lines.en: Am I?
lines.zh: 我会吗？

lines.en: Ami?
lines.zh: Ami？

lines.en: I should text Ami.
lines.zh: 我应该给 Ami 发消息。

lines.en: Ami will know what to do.
lines.zh: Ami 会知道该怎么办。

lines.en: Ami is so cute. Ami always helps me no matter what situation I’m in.
lines.zh: Ami 那么可爱。不管我处在什么处境，Ami 总会帮我。

lines.en: I can trust her.
lines.zh: 我可以信任她。

lines.en: scene black
I tap on Ami’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Ami 的名字,等她接听。

lines.en: scene goodboy8
{i}You did it!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你做到了！{/i}

lines.en: {i}You made it through the event without molesting a girl!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你全程没有骚扰任何女孩，撑过来了！{/i}

lines.en: {i}All of that hard work and harsh training must have paid off!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那些刻苦的努力和严酷的训练，一定都值回票价了！{/i}

lines.en: {i}For a limited time, please enjoy being a trophy!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}限时福利，请好好享受当奖杯的感觉吧！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Your limbs will return to normal the second we think they should.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}等我们认为时机到了，你的四肢会立刻恢复正常。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But, in the meantime, please remember that bad things only happen to bad children!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过在那之前，请记住：坏事只会发生在坏孩子身上！{/i}

lines.en: {i}And, so long as you be good, you’ll live a happy, carefree life! Where everyone loves you and {i}thinks you’re going to do great things.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}所以，只要你一直乖，你就会过上幸福无忧的生活！人人都爱你，{i}都觉得你将来会干一番大事业。{/i}{/i}

lines.en: {i}Are you going to do great things? {/i}
lines.zh: {i}你会干一番大事业的，对吧？{/i}

lines.en: {i}You’re a good boy now, but how long will that last?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你现在是个好孩子了，可这份好能持续多久？{/i}

lines.en: {i}How long until you start wanting to do {i}bad{/i} things?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}还要多久，你就会开始想做{i}坏{/i}事？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Bad things are bad! And good things are good!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}坏事就是坏的！好事就是好的！{/i}

lines.en: {i}So just do what you’re told and everything will turn out a-okay!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}所以照吩咐去做，一切都会没事的！{/i}

lines.en: {i}I love you so much.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我那么爱你。{/i}

lines.en: {i}If I didn’t, why would I do this?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}如果我不爱你，我为什么要做这些？{/i}

lines.en: A hand reaches out and [[REDACTED] [[REDACTED] my [[REDACTED].
lines.zh: 一只手伸了过来，[已编辑] [已编辑] 我的 [已编辑]。

lines.en: I’m scared that I might [[REDACTED], but [[REDACTED] assures me that it’s totally normal if I do.
lines.zh: 我害怕自己可能会 [已编辑]，但 [已编辑] 向我保证，就算会也完全正常。

lines.en: She [[REDACTED] my [[REDACTED] and some of the blood from my hand gets into her hair.
lines.zh: 她 [已编辑] 我的 [已编辑]，我手上的一些血流进了她的头发。

lines.en: It’s hard to see because of the color, but that doesn’t stop me from trying to focus on it as she continues to [[REDACTED].
lines.zh: 因为颜色的关系很难看清，但这不妨碍我一边努力盯着它，一边任由她继续 [已编辑]。

lines.en: Before long, we [[REDACTED].
lines.zh: 没过多久，我们就 [已编辑]。

lines.en: The cut on my hand opens back up.
lines.zh: 我手上的伤口又裂开了。

lines.en: I think it’s infected.
lines.zh: 我觉得它感染了。

: Thank you for coming.
lines.zh: : 感谢你的到来。

lines.en: : We have all been waiting with bated breath.
lines.zh: : 我们都屏息以待很久了。

lines.en: : What...is this?
lines.zh: : 这……是什么？

lines.en: : Who are you?
lines.zh: : 你是谁？

lines.en: : I am the host of today’s talk show event, and you are our very special guest.
lines.zh: : 我是今天这场脱口秀节目的主持人，而您是我们非常特别的嘉宾。

lines.en: : I would like to thank you for coming and agreeing to pour your heart out onto the floor beneath us.
lines.zh: : 我要感谢您愿意前来，并同意把您的心掏出来，倒在我们脚下的地板上。

lines.en: I stand at the edge of a stage I never wanted to set foot on, searching for shade to avoid having my skin singed by the spotlights spread out above me.
lines.zh: 我站在一座我从未想踏上去的舞台边缘，四处寻找阴影，以免被头顶铺开的聚光灯灼伤皮肤。

lines.en: There is no audience, just a small camera crew and a blue sky spreading so far that it feels as if we’re suspended in mid air.
lines.zh: 没有观众，只有一小队摄像人员，以及一片辽阔得让我们仿佛悬在半空中的蓝天。

lines.en: : I would like to begin the show with this question first:
lines.zh: : 我想用下面这个问题来开场：

lines.en: : How did you wind up here today?
lines.zh: : 你今天是怎么走到这一步的？

lines.en: : I don’t want to be here.
lines.zh: : 我不想待在这儿。

lines.en: : If you don’t intend to answer the questions properly, we will have you removed from the show.
lines.zh: : 如果你不打算好好回答问题，我们会请你离场。

lines.en: : Yes, please. That is what I want.
lines.zh: : 好，请吧。那正是我想要的。

lines.en: : Are you sure about that?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？

lines.en: : What? Of course I'm-
lines.zh: : 什么？我当然——

lines.en: scene black
: I can’t see! What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 我看不见了！怎么回事？

lines.en: : I had your eyesight taken away.
lines.zh: : 我让人把你的视力收走了。

lines.en: : You see, this is a very special program. And here, we’re allowed to do very special things.
lines.zh: : 你看，这是一档非常特别的节目。而在这里，我们被允许做非常特别的事。

lines.en: : Being removed from the show doesn’t mean you just get to go home, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，被请离场并不意味着你就可以直接回家。

lines.en: : It means your entire existence is wiped clean.
lines.zh: : 它的意思是，你的整个存在会被抹得一干二净。

lines.en: : And something like that would make {i}me{/i}, in particular, very {i}very{/i} sad.
lines.zh: : 而那样的事，会让{i}我{/i}个人非常{i}非常{/i}难过。

lines.en: : Okay, fine. I’ll do what you want. Just-
lines.zh: : 好，好吧。我照你说的做。只是——

lines.en: scene goodboy9
: Splendid.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: : So, how is it you ended up here today?
lines.zh: : 那么，你今天是怎么走到这一步的？

lines.en: : I have no idea. I was just...doing what I normally do and wound up here.
lines.zh: : 我毫无头绪。我只是……做着我平时做的事，然后就到了这儿。

lines.en: : Were you?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Yes. I’m...pretty sure I was.
lines.zh: : 是的。我……挺确定的。

lines.en: : Hmm...
: Well, there’s no rule against {i}lying{/i}, so I suppose we can just move on to the next question.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这里也没有不许{i}说谎{/i}的规矩，那我们就进入下一个问题吧。

lines.en: scene goodboy10
: You’re sitting at the computer with your friends and family in the room right behind you. They’re not paying much attention to what you’re doing.
lines.zh: : 你正坐在电脑前，朋友和家人在你身后的房间里。他们没怎么在意你在干什么。

lines.en: : Then, suddenly, you accidentally click on a pop up for a porn site and know that, within seconds, a video is going to play.
lines.zh: : 然后突然，你不小心点开了一个色情网站的弹窗，你知道几秒钟之内就会有一段视频开始播放。

lines.en: : Your speakers are on full blast because it’s actually a Christmas party, and the Christmas music is about to be replaced with audible sex noises.
lines.zh: : 你的音箱开到了最大，因为这其实是一场圣诞派对，圣诞歌马上就要被清晰的性爱声取代了。

lines.en: : How do you handle the situation?
lines.zh: : 你会怎么处理这个局面？

lines.en: : This is what you’re threatening to take my vision away for?
lines.zh: : 你就是为了这个威胁要收走我的视力？

lines.en: : I’m just trying to get to know you better.
lines.zh: : 我只是想多了解你一点。

lines.en: : Whatever. I unplug the computer as quickly as I can.
lines.zh: : 随便吧。我会以最快的速度拔掉电脑插头。

lines.en: : Noooo, don’t do that. You’ll hurt it.
lines.zh: : 不——不要那样。你会弄坏它的。

lines.en: : I really don’t care.
lines.zh: : 我真的不在乎。

lines.en: : Well, you should. Computers are important.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你该在乎的。电脑很重要的。

lines.en: : You’ll never know when one might come in handy.
lines.zh: : 你永远不知道它什么时候能派上用场。

lines.en: : In fact, you might owe a lot more to computers than you think!
lines.zh: : 事实上，你对电脑的亏欠，可能比你自己以为的要多得多！

lines.en: : Are you going to tell me how? Or am I just going to have to pretend to understand what you’re talking about?
lines.zh: : 你要告诉我为什么吗？还是说我只能假装听懂你在说什么？

lines.en: : All I’m saying is that we don’t get to do this program very often and that you should maybe be a {i}little{/i} more cooperative if you want to be a return-guest.
lines.zh: : 我只是想说，我们这档节目不常有机会做，如果你想当回头客，也许该配合{i}一点{/i}。

lines.en: : But, with that, I will now turn things over to our senior correspondent, Moyo Makinamo.
lines.zh: : 不过，就此我把时间交给我们的资深记者，Moyo Makinamo。

lines.en: : Take it away, Moyo.
lines.zh: : 交给你了，Moyo。

lines.en: scene goodboy14
scene goodboy15
scene goodboy14
: I couldn’t have said it better myself.
lines.zh: : 我自己也说不出比这更好的了。

lines.en: Before I can even think of a response to the ear piercing shriek I just heard, I find myself once again fighting back the urge to vomit, albeit with much less success this time.
lines.zh: 我还没想好该怎么回应刚刚那声刺穿耳膜的尖叫，就发现自己又在跟呕吐的冲动搏斗，只不过这一次没那么成功。

lines.en: Within seconds, I’m spewing a mixture of yellowish bile and what I think might be blood onto the tiled floor.
lines.zh: 几秒钟之内，我就把混着黄绿色胆汁、还有我觉得可能是血的东西吐在了瓷砖地板上。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about cleaning that up, it will evaporate within seconds.
lines.zh: : 别担心打扫的事，它几秒钟之内就会蒸发掉。

lines.en: : But, seeing as I forgot how Moyo is unable to speak without the vibrations of her voice causing the liquids in human innards to boil, let’s just move on to our third speaker.
lines.zh: : 不过，既然我忘了 Moyo 一开口，她声音的振动就会让人五脏六腑里的液体沸腾，那我们就直接进入第三位发言人的环节吧。

lines.en: scene goodboy12
: Chair, do you have anything you’d like to ask our guest?
lines.zh: : 椅子，你有什么想问我们嘉宾的吗？

lines.en: I finish coughing up bile and look at the chair.
lines.zh: 我咳完胆汁，看向那把椅子。

lines.en: I know I’m being toyed with at this point, but there’s not really anything I can do about it without risking my eyesight and...whatever else these {i}people{/i} can take from me.
lines.zh: 我知道自己这会儿正被耍着玩，但冒着失去视力——以及这些{i}人{/i}还能从我身上拿走别的什么——的风险，我实在无能为力。

lines.en: : I see, I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了，我明白了。

lines.en: : Would you mind translating for me?...
lines.zh: : 能麻烦你帮我翻译一下吗？……

lines.en: scene goodboy13
: Translating what, exactly? It didn’t say anything.
lines.zh: : 翻译什么？它什么都没说啊。

lines.en: : In fact, Chair has yet to say {i}anything{/i} in any episode of this program. But we’re still holding out hope that it does one day.
lines.zh: : 事实上，椅子在这档节目的任何一集里都还没{i}开过口{/i}。但我们依然抱着希望，指望它有朝一日会说点什么。

lines.en: : It might be time to find a replacement for that {i}speaker{/i} then.
lines.zh: : 那也许该给这位{i}发言人{/i}找个替补了。

lines.en: : We had a fourth, but she stopped coming for some reason.
lines.zh: : 我们本来有第四位，但她不知为什么不再来了。

lines.en: : I think she may have just gotten bored.
lines.zh: : 我想她可能只是觉得无聊了吧。

lines.en: : But anyway, we’re running out of time, so I’d like to ask you one final thing before we conclude today’s show.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，我们时间不多了，所以在今天的节目收尾前，我想最后问你一件事。

lines.en: scene goodboy16
: Our records show that, in addition to various illicit relationships with your students, you’re also engaging in a sexual relationship with a student’s mother.

lines.zh: : 我这里记录着，她失去了一个儿子，{i}也{/i}失去了伴侣。听起来挺沉重的打击。

lines.en: : Do you think she’s any happier now that she gets to experience the sensation of your oversized sex organ inside of her?

lines.en: : In fact, there are several species known with recorded evidence of recreational sex.
